pressure_regulation: Built-in PRS-45 stem regulates nozzle pressure to 45 psi for inlet pressures from 50 to 70 psi; below 50 psi, pressure loss does not exceed 6 psi.
compatibility_notes: Designed for Rain Bird plastic spray head nozzles; 45 psi is recommended for optimal rotary-nozzle performance.
installation_constraints: Side or bottom inlet. Side-inlet installation is not recommended in freezing climates.
notes: 12 inch pop-up height and 16 inch body height. PRS models are WaterSense certified. The spray body has no independent nozzle performance table; radius, flow, and precipitation depend on the installed nozzle.
